Subject: Packaging decision: tier upgrade vs bundled add-ons — Veridian Health

Hi Jonas,

We’re evaluating whether to move Veridian onto Redwood’s Throughput tier or stay on Standard and buy the 'Advanced NLP + Analytics' add-on pack. A few items we need to decide before procurement engages:

- Cost delta for Standard + feature pack vs Throughput tier (monthly / annualized)
- What exactly is included with Throughput (KV cache sizing, priority routing, SLA differences)
- Upgrade/downgrade window and proration rules (we have a Q3 go-live target)
- Is there any flexibility on list price for an annual commit? Procurement expects a discount ask, likely 15–25% depending on term.

We have an internal deadline in three weeks to lock a preferred option to fit the implementation plan. Can you send a short comparison (one-pager) and a recommended path? If there’s room to discuss a pilot concession or short-term burst credits to mitigate cost while we validate, that would be helpful.

Thanks,
Priyanka Rao
Sr. Product Manager — Veridian Health
priya@veridianhealth.com
(415) 555-0134

P.S. Procurement may loop in their legal counsel after we pick the option — heads up.
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging decision: tier upgrade vs bundled add-ons — Veridian Health

Hi Priyanka — thanks for the clear outline. High level options below; I’ll attach a concise comparison PDF.

Option A — Throughput Tier (recommended if latency + predictable TTK matter)
- Monthly list: $9,800/mo (example for current profile)
- Includes: dedicated KV cache footprint for hot prefixes, priority routing, 99.9% token-level latency SLOs, 24x7 support on incidents
- Upgrade: immediate; Downgrade: next billing cycle with standard proration; requires 30-day notice for capacity rebalancing

Option B — Standard + Advanced NLP & Analytics add-on (recommended if mostly feature-driven)
- Monthly list: $6,500/mo (Standard $4,500 + add-ons $2,000)
- Includes: analytics dashboard, advanced reranking, per-route token tagging; no dedicated KV cache (shared)
- Upgrade: add-on can be enabled immediately; moving to Throughput later is supported with migration assistance

Option C — Hybrid pilot (short-term burst + feature bundle)
- Short-term burst credits to simulate Throughput behavior for 3 months + feature bundle at reduced pilot rate

Two asks from my side to give a tighter number: recent 90-day token/month and peak qps so I can size KV cache and throughput.

I’ll prepare the one-pager and a spreadsheet with exact pricing lines. Do you have time for a 30-minute workshop next week to walk the team through tradeoffs?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Veridian’s ask. Key points: they want a clear recommendation and procurement is expecting a 15–25% discount window. They need a decision in ~3 weeks; likely deal HS-9932.

My proposed commercial approach:
- Offer A: Throughput tier at list $9,800/mo; 15% recurring discount for a 12-month commitment (annual prepay preferred).
- Offer B: Standard + feature bundle at list $6,500/mo; 15% recurring for 12-month, or 20% one-time pilot credit if they want a 3-month evaluation.

They asked explicitly if we can do 20% off list for an annual agreement. I think we can offer 15% standard and escalate for 20% pilot credit (one-time credit applied to first invoice) — that keeps ARR math intact.

Do you approve 15% recurring on committed ACV for this segment? If you’re ok with 20% recurring we should get exec/legal sign-off and require a statement of work. I’ve included the deal link HS-9932 in HubSpot.

Thanks — need a quick call or note back so I can reply to Priyanka today.

— Jonas

- 20% one-time pilot credit available (applied to invoice 1) for a 3-month limited evaluation.
